_comment: Donor table for the completeness merge (S4) and the per-weight Fira donor
map for the ligaturizer (S5). Scales are MEASURED at build time from each
donor's own drawn 'x' and 'H' bounding boxes, never from OS/2 (Maple's OS/2
says x=550 cap=730 while the ink tops at 560/740). The 'scale' value below
is the assertion the build checks the measurement against, not the value it
uses; braille is the one exception and takes an exact 2.0 (note B).
NOTE B: braille cells are a geometric dot lattice, not a letterform. An
x-height-derived scale would shrink the lattice relative to the cell and
break the 2x4 grid alignment against block characters; 1000->2000 upm is
exactly 2.0 and keeps every dot on an integer coordinate.
SPEC-v2 corrections (2026-09-17): the donor list below is documentation; lib/merge.py
carries the executable table (jb/dv/maple, the dvr weight fall-through for heavy faces,
the jbs/dvs/mps/dvrs sheared slope fall-through for italics). Scales are measured from
ink at run time; braille takes exactly 2.0 on CELL-RATIO grounds (Maple 600/1000 = host
1200/2000), not roundness, and gets dy=+55 so its ink centre lands on the cell centre.

donors.name: JetBrains Mono Nerd Font
donors.note: nixpkgs installs this at share/fonts/truetype/NerdFonts/JetBrainsMono/. Use the NerdFontMono cut: 600/1000 upm = 0.600 em, an EXACT 2.0 to the Anthropic 1200/2000 cell.

donors.name: Maple Mono NF
donors.note: Braille donor: 256/256 on the ROMAN cuts only (italic cuts are 255/256, U+2800 synthesised). Also offered the text ranges at the ink scale (16-18 glyphs/face). MEASURED to have ZERO CJK, Kana and Hangul: never map those ranges to it.

_empty_glyph_comment: U+2800 BRAILLE PATTERN BLANK: every MapleMono-NF-*Italic cut omits it from the cmap entirely (255/256); the Roman cuts map it to nbspace. When no donor maps it, merge.py synthesises a contour-less glyph with advance 1200 and asserts 256/256.
_anchor_comment: A constituent whose host drawing sits on the baseline (or on the opposite side of the x-centre from the donor's) vetoes the whole ligature: its delta is meaningless. lig.74 (the '__' ligature) is the measured case - its y-centre is -297 against the host underscore at -401.5, and a blanket +93 moves it AWAY from target.
_fira_comment: Fira Code 3.001 ships nothing heavier than Bold, so ExtraBold reuses FiraCode-Bold: its dash is 252.3/2000 against Anthropic's 300, a 47.7-unit (2.4% em, ~1.0px at 16pt) shortfall. Documented and NOT fixed - kitty uses Regular + SemiBold.
